# Support

Start with [installation and troubleshooting](../docs/getting-started.md) and [model connections](../docs/ai-connections.md). For reproducible software bugs use an issue; for questions and research ideas use Discussions.

Include release, operating system, Python/Node versions when applicable, mode, expected result and a minimal synthetic reproduction. Remove credentials, recovery codes, account cookies, database contents, private world truth and personal information from screenshots and logs.

Security reports follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md). The repository does not operate or administer independently hosted instances; contact that installation's operator for access or data requests. Community maintenance provides no paid SLA or guaranteed response time.
